phrase.zh: 智能体行为不端，用户却步

phrase.en: Twitch users outraged by AI data use

phrase.zh: 披露说服意图降低说服力

gloss.en: From lying agents to hidden training data, AI's trust problem surfaces everywhere.
gloss.zh: 从撒谎的智能体到隐藏的训练数据，AI的信任问题处处显现。

why_now.en: You care about human-AI interaction and communication: today multiple sources confront AI's opaque, sometimes deceptive behavior.
why_now.zh: 你关心人机交互与传播，今日多家来源直面AI的不透明乃至欺骗行为。

phrase.en: Specialized RAG beats frontier LLMs in clinical
phrase.zh: 专用RAG在临床上胜过前沿LLM
同一提示，11个模型结果迥异

gloss.en: Benchmarks clash with real-world use; models diverge and overpromise.
gloss.zh: 基准测试与现实应用冲突，模型结果不一且过度承诺。

why_now.en: You follow LLMs closely: today's evidence shows specialized vs. general models and prompt variability, key for your work.
why_now.zh: 你密切关注LLM，今日证据显示专用与通用模型之别及提示变异性，关乎你的工作。

phrase.en: AI 3D models flood market, few buy
ESL learners collaborate via AI slides
phrase.zh: ESL学习者通过AI幻灯片协作

gloss.en: AI churns out 3D models and slides, but buyers and learners hesitate.
gloss.zh: AI批量生成3D模型和幻灯片，但买家和学习者却犹豫不决。

why_now.en: You study human-computer interaction and visual communication: today's stories show the gap between AI output and real adoption.
why_now.zh: 你研究人机交互与视觉传播，今日新闻展示AI产出与实际采用之间的鸿沟。

phrase.en: Wearable glove adds haptics in XR
phrase.zh: 可穿戴手套为XR增加触觉

phrase.en: Brain-computer interface ethics in mental health
phrase.zh: 脑机接口在心理保健中的伦理

gloss.en: Touch and body awareness enter digital experience, from gloves to brain interfaces.
gloss.zh: 触觉与身体意识进入数字体验，从手套到脑机接口。

why_now.en: You're interested in embodied AI and embodied cognition: today's papers push physical sensing into HCI and ethics.
why_now.zh: 你对具身AI和具身认知感兴趣，今日论文将物理感知推进到人机交互与伦理。

phrase.zh: 可审计的AI辅助研究写作

gloss.en: Research writing and institutional messages grapple with AI's role and accountability.
gloss.zh: 研究写作与机构信息在处理AI的角色与责任。

why_now.en: You care about technical communication: today's studies question how AI fits into writing and crisis messaging.
why_now.zh: 你关注技术传播，今日研究质疑AI如何融入写作与危机传播。
